text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen, where the Umamusume we look up to gather...
It's finally here.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: When I think about how I was able to make it all the way to this grand finale...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: It kinda makes you laugh, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes. At first, pushing myself to the limit
was something I couldn't do at all~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, or maybe rather than 'at first,' it's 'even now.'
She's still got that soft spot just like always...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: “B-But we made it! We made it all the way here!”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm heading out!
choice_data_list: Yeah, go make a miracle happen!
Yeah, go make a miracle happen!

text_block_list.text: Carrying a small dream with her, Hishi Miracle makes her way toward the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-chan, Tap-chan,
Rob Roy-chan, Digital-chan,
sorry to keep you waiting~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Let's have fun today too! It'd be great
if everyone could give it their all, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, aren't you carefree?
You never change...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――?
The Aura... is different.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle.
Did you see it――the Mission?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... it's not really grand enough
to be called a "mission," though~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I think I understand a little now. What I want to do,
and what only I can do."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Huh? What on earth is that?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: That is—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: To win, even without a dream!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
No dream, no mission...
And you think you can win with that?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking, you know? Kris S and the others
are so impressive. They set proper goals
and work hard toward them.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I respect it, but I just can't do it.
Even when I tried, it was impossible.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: If I get all fired up out of character and push myself too hard, I might end up getting injured...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Giving in to laziness and sweet temptations...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Still, with the help of Trainer and everyone around me, I gasped and wheezed my way all the way here.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“Still, though, isn't that actually kind of amazing?
I mean, having this little willpower
and still making it this far?”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Doing my best within what I can do, supported by
so many people. Just that... is enough!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If someone like me can win on this stage,
it proves that anyone can have a shot, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I don't really have any dreams of my own, but maybe my winning gives other people something to dream about.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—I see. Puzzling.
It is difficult to understand, but...”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Those are some... new values.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, for someone playing dumb,
you sure talk big.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I am deeply moved! As the saying goes, true greatness comes from rising from humble beginnings.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So basically like a Level 100 Villager?!
A-A new archetype is born...!

Their words differed, but it seemed everyone had
become much more conscious of Hishi Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Umm, so to all my fans,
that's how it is~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'd be really happy if you could watch over me with warmth.
And so...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: If there's anyone who hoped something unexpected might happen...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Please take a chance on me.
Just bet a little bit of your dream on me!
(WOOOOAAAH!)
Dreams take many forms. None are good or bad; all have equal value. And among them—

—A dream without a dream is still a dream.
Shouldering countless small expectations,
Hishi Miracle runs on.
